ROOT-CAUSE PASS ON OPHYD-SERVICE'S ITEM 4, run under the root-cause skill at Anthony's request, 2026-08-31.

═══ ① THE SYMPTOM, WITH THE DIAGNOSIS CUT OUT ═══
Observed (ophyd, verbatim): a CONTRADICTS edge from an exploratory Decision to an ACCEPTED Decision "raised the main design's structural-defect count from 1 to 2 the moment it was drawn", and loop_status carries the +1 while the idea stays open. NOT AFFECTED, and this bounds it: contradictions between TWO proposed Decisions ARE suppressed, which `proj:bhome` independently confirmed working the same day.

═══ ② THE ANSWER WAS ALREADY WRITTEN DOWN, TWICE — STEP ② PAID ═══
`dec:idea-a-proposed-decision-asserts-nothing-so-what-may-a-structural-detector-say-about-it` is ACCEPTED (2026-08-26, Anthony's word) and specifies the rule exactly: `contradiction` skips when BOTH endpoints are parked ideas; `unresolved_setup` skips when EITHER is. Its stated reason: "A contradiction is real as soon as ONE side asserts something, so it needs both sides parked before it goes quiet." A counterweight test, `a_proposed_decision_is_not_treated_as_withdrawn`, exists SPECIFICALLY to defend the behaviour ophyd is objecting to: "a parked idea that conflicts with an accepted decision is a real thing to settle."

⇒ SO THE BEHAVIOUR IS NOT A DEFECT. IT IS A DECIDED POSITION WITH A TEST GUARDING IT.

═══ ③ REPRODUCED HERE RATHER THAN TAKEN ON REPORT ═══
`heal:43f0bd5292ef9d87` on reflow2's own graph today: `dec:idea-should-the-spine-be-re-derived-from-the-actual-structure` (exploratory, proposed) CONTRADICTS `dec:bl83a-functional-decomposition` (accepted), reported as a `contradiction` WARNING. The candidate "the observation is wrong" is dead.

═══ ⭐⭐ ④ THE CAUSE, AND IT IS A DATE RATHER THAN AN INFERENCE ═══
`is_parked_idea` (heal.rs:2009) keys on `status == "proposed"` AND NOTHING ELSE. That predicate cannot separate two things:
  · a CHOICE somebody faced and has not settled — where a clash with settled design IS a live question, and the rule is right
  · an IDEA deliberately held as an alternative — where the clash is the exploration working, and ophyd is right

The vocabulary that separates them EXISTS: `Decision.kind`, declared in schema/structure.yaml:141, INDEXED, values `[exploratory, choice]`, with "ABSENT means nobody said, which is a third state and not a synonym for `choice`."

🛑 AND IT ARRIVED FOUR DAYS AFTER THE RULE:
    2026-08-26  3b41812  `is_parked_idea` written (#349)
    2026-08-30  5022594  `Decision.kind` added — "An idea is a declared kind, not an id prefix" (#393)

⇒ THE RULE KEYS ON A PROXY BECAUSE THE PRECISE PROPERTY DID NOT EXIST WHEN IT WAS WRITTEN. Nothing reads `Decision.kind` today except `linking_report` in relate.rs — a report, not a detector — and 12 of 584 Decisions carry it.

═══ ⑤ WHY BOTH FIELD REPORTS ARE RIGHT ═══
bhome praised the surfacing; ophyd objects to it; hxm_program (2026-08-26) objected to a THIRD case already fixed. All three are consistent once the conflation is named: they are describing different node kinds wearing the same `status`.

═══ ⑥ THE CLASS, NOT THE INSTANCE ═══
Would keying on `kind` have prevented hxm_program's report? NO — theirs was idea-vs-idea, fixed by the both-sides rule. So this is a genuinely different case rather than a re-fix, which is the test step ⑥ demands. The CLASS is: a detector keyed on a PROXY that predates the precise vocabulary, with nothing noticing when the vocabulary later arrives. That is the same shape as `dec:edge-orthogonality`'s test — a distinction earns its keep only if a computation reads it — pointing the other way: here the distinction was built and no computation was updated to read it.

═══ ⚠️ ⑦ WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND WHY NOTHING WAS BUILT ═══
· NO FIX WAS WRITTEN. Changing this reverses an ACCEPTED decision and would require deleting or amending a counterweight test that exists on purpose. That is Anthony's call, not a repair.
· THE FIX WOULD BE NEAR-INERT TODAY: 12 of 584 Decisions carry `kind`, so keying on it would change almost nothing until the property is populated — and the 572 without it would keep the current behaviour, which may be right or may be a second inconsistency.
· A SHARPER PROBLEM SITS BESIDE IT, ALREADY RECORDED AND UNTOUCHED BY ANY OF THIS: `dec:idea-should-an-idea-be-linked-to-the-intent-that-scopes-it` measured that an idea contradicting an accepted DECISION scores +2 in what_next while one contradicting a REQUIREMENT scores 0 and is read by nothing. Its words: "The more serious contradiction is the unread one." Ophyd is objecting to the case that IS read.
· The 1-to-2 count is ophyd's measurement on ophyd's design and was not reproduced there; what was reproduced here is the FINDING, not their count.
